# Roadmap

Goal: One person logs daily habits and sees current streaks.
Not doing: accounts, sync, email.
Constraints:
- Users: one person, one browser
- Data: a few check-ins a day; never lose a check-in
- Runs on: one small VM

| P03 | Daily reminders | approved | [plan](plans/P03-daily-reminders.md) |
| P04 | Weekly summary | planned | — |

Outlines:
- **P04** A weekly summary page for each habit. Depends on: P02. Risk: none.
